answer: I found two help-center articles in effect today that still tell customers to use a retired form. "Broken or replaced odometer" tells customers to use odometer statement form NW-ODO-1. NW-ODO-2 replaced that form on February 1, 2026. "Selling a family member's car for them" tells customers to have NW-POA-1 signed in front of a notary. NW-POA-2 replaced NW-POA-1 on February 1, 2026, and a signed NW-POA-1 was accepted only until June 30, 2026. I searched for other retired forms and found no more, but search may not catch every article.
